name: Yuukai Hakusho
source:
A high school girl was missing for three days and then her violated corpse was discovered in the park near protagonist house. Yagami Shingo is into detective business with his partner and he accepts this case that looks very much like kidnapping.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-october-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一名女高中生失踪三天后，她被发现死在主人公家附近的公园里，死状显示曾遭到侵犯。八神真吾与搭档一起经营侦探事务所，接下了这起看似绑架案的案件。

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2017/08/vn-of-month-october-1997.html]vndbreview[/url]]
